excerpt: Quantum methods can make Boltzmann systems thermalize quadratically faster, reduce the samples needed to learn performance, and use quadratically fewer accesses to training data under qRAM or black-box access.
overview: The Boltzmann-machine evidence is concrete because it identifies where quantum resources enter training: thermalization, sampling, and data access. The gains are conditional on coherent access models and do not by themselves remove the input bottleneck for arbitrary classical data.
title: Quadratic Boltzmann Training Gains
